_comment: Display metadata for the model questions. Everything here is optional: a question found in the data but missing here is still published (type, levels and choices come from the model answers, the description from the vendored fminer.classify.QUESTIONS). 'order' sorts filters/columns; 'primary' marks the score used by presets and the default sort.

fr.label: Feature request
fr._bands: Filters and chips use these bands instead of the 5 levels: the model's expected score bunches up mid-scale (even the Feature Request category's median is 2.88 of 4), so rounding to the nearest level leaves 'Most likely' almost empty. Each band's lower bound is a quantile of the scores this run gave to the reference set (the Feature Request category), computed per run by build_data.py. A spot check of 50 topics outside the category (Oct 2026) found ~85% real requests from 2.5 up, ~60-75% between ~1.75 and 2.5, and ~10% below 1.75.

bands.label: High
bands.long: scores like the top 75% of Feature Request category posts

bands.label: Medium
bands.long: scores like the lowest 5–25% of Feature Request category posts; often an implicit request

bands.label: Low
bands.long: scores below 95% of Feature Request category posts
